name: Chirisa Technology Parks

profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 87 (Chirisa Technology Parks missing-address campaign): applied 201 Centennial Avenue, Piscataway, sourced from convergence of a reverse geocode of this rows own coordinates and an independent, name specific aggregator listing for this exact facility, which also identifies this as a former building of a different, already researched operator in this registry, consistent with the operators own adaptive reuse description.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Per Chirisa Technology Parks own site, this Piscataway, New Jersey facility (PNJ-01/PNJ-02) is a 20 acre site combining adaptive reuse of an existing building shell with an adjacent two story greenfield development. The site states 90 MW of power by mid-2026 and describes the space as reserved for 2027 delivery, meaning this is a planned or committed future capacity figure rather than a confirmed current operating critical IT load, and is recorded here as planned capacity rather than critical_it_mw. No total square footage figure is published on this page. This session resolved the street address. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 201 Centennial Avenue, Piscataway, NJ 08854 at 0.9 confidence, and a dedicated, name specific listing for this exact facility on a data center industry aggregator independently gives the identical address, describing the site as operated by Chirisa Investments and previously managed under a different, already researched operator name in this registry. A separate general area listing on the same aggregator shows that earlier operators building at the same street number with a distinct suite letter, consistent with a change of operator at this address rather than two unrelated buildings, and helping explain the operators own adaptive reuse of an existing building shell description. Given this convergence of an independent coordinate based method and a name specific aggregator listing, this session applies 201 Centennial Avenue as this rows address.

reading: Chirisa Technology Parks is a privately held data center developer building hyperscale, high performance computing, and AI-focused campuses across North America and Europe through both brownfield conversions and greenfield construction. The company's largest US site is a 230 to 350 acre campus near Richmond, Virginia, with 534,000 square feet operational or under construction and a targeted 360 megawatts of power by the end of 2026, alongside a fully operational 28 megawatt campus in Chicago, a 20 acre, 90 megawatt Piscataway, New Jersey site targeted for mid-2026, an operational 13 megawatt adaptive reuse facility in Lynnwood, Washington, and a 150 acre, four-building master-planned site in Lancaster, Pennsylvania with up to 440 megawatts available. Chirisa reports more than 850,000 square feet of operational space and a US development pipeline exceeding 1 gigawatt. In 2025, Chirisa formed a joint venture with Blue Owl Capital and PowerHouse, another private developer already profiled in this registry, with capacity to deploy up to 5 billion dollars in capital for turnkey AI and HPC data center developments, advised by real estate firm Newmark; the JV's initial phase delivers 120 megawatts for CoreWeave across 2025 and 2026, with further expansion planned in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Texas, Kentucky, and Nevada. Chirisa's exact corporate headquarters city was not published on its own site as of the research date. Its combination of a large power-dense Virginia flagship campus, an institutional capital partner in Blue Owl, and a named hyperscale AI tenant in CoreWeave places it alongside Vantage, STACK, and Aligned as a fast-scaling, well-capitalized wholesale developer rather than a legacy regional colocation provider.
